title: sokf init report
description: `InitResult` is the report of `sokf init --json`: it holds the directory of the store that the command created. It also holds the files that the command wrote (CLI-2_AC-12).

root.description: `root` is the directory of the store that the command created.

created.description: `created` holds the files that the command created, ordered by path.

updated.description: `updated` holds the files that the command changed, ordered by path. The list holds `/.sokf/config.toml` when the command added the store to `knowledge.roots`, and is empty otherwise.

RepoPath.description: A path relative to the repository root, which starts with `/` and uses forward slashes. The path `/` is the root itself.
